placeholder.label: Before the battle: a grey morning, our war-band forming its shield line before a palisaded town, the leader pointing, the defenders gathering on the bank ahead. Subject on the right two thirds; the left third stays calm for text.

The field is ours: evening, our warriors on a taken earth bank with a broken palisade, spears raised as the banner is planted, the last of the enemy running for the trees. Subject on the right two thirds; the left third stays calm for text.

The day is lost: dusk, our men falling back toward the ships carrying a wounded friend, the enemy line dark on the ridge behind, not following. Subject on the right two thirds; the left third stays calm for text.
